title: Agent Definition
description: Schema for agents/*.yaml files. Rust agov is the current AGF v2 operator validator surface; historical v1.x Python validators are legacy reference material. Cross-artefact invariants (manifest closure, ownership-overlap detection, communication symmetry) live in schemas/invariants.yaml.

name.description: Kebab-case agent name; matches the YAML filename without extension.

version.description: Semantic version of this agent definition.

framework_version.description: Version of framework.md this definition conforms to. The pre-tag-check enforces equality with VERSION at release time.

provenance.description: Origin and verification status of this agent definition relative to AGF v2. inherited-v1x-unverified: carried from v1.x with no v2 review; adapted-from-v1x: touched during v2 development but not fully reviewed; verified-agf-v2: explicitly reviewed against AGF v2 operating model; foundry-native: created natively for AGF v2.

activation_condition.description: The concrete adopter-specific trigger for this role's function being needed, independent of tier/phase library membership. 'always' for roles needed from the first governed change.

local_deactivation.description: How to stop using this role in a project's own manifest/config without touching agf/. Reversible, no forfeited guarantee beyond this role's own function.

definition_removal.description: What deleting agf/agents/<name>.yaml itself forfeits — normally worse than local deactivation, since it removes the reusable definition, not just this project's use of it.

receives_from.description: List of agents this agent receives messages from. Each entry may be a structured object with `agent` and `message_types` (preferred) or a plain string (legacy short form).

sends_to.description: List of agents this agent sends messages to. Same shape as receives_from.

cannot_contact.description: List of agents this agent must not contact directly.

review_checklists.description: Domain-specific review checklists (per-change and per-milestone). Free-form by design — adopters extend with project-specific items.

review_dimensions.description: Optional dimensions some governance/review agents declare; free-form.

report_structure.description: Optional report-shape declaration some agents (e.g. fact-checker) carry.
